import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from torch import nn
from tiny_perceptron.model import TinyLM,ModelConfig
from tiny_perceptron.multimodal import MultiModalLM
root=Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm');torch.manual_seed(0)
lm=TinyLM(ModelConfig(width=8)).eval();mm=MultiModalLM(lm).eval();ids=torch.tensor([1,20,30]);before=lm(ids[None])['logits'].detach().clone();wrapped=mm(ids)['logits'];assert torch.equal(before,wrapped)
mm.requires_grad_(False);mm.image_projector.requires_grad_(True);parameters=[p for p in mm.parameters() if p.requires_grad];optim=torch.optim.AdamW(parameters,lr=0.001)
old_lm={n:p.detach().clone() for n,p in lm.state_dict().items()};old_projector={n:p.detach().clone() for n,p in mm.image_projector.state_dict().items()}
vision=torch.randn(1,16,16);loss=mm.image_projector(vision).square().mean();optim.zero_grad();loss.backward();optim.step()
assert all(torch.equal(p,lm.state_dict()[n]) for n,p in old_lm.items());assert any(not torch.equal(p,mm.image_projector.state_dict()[n]) for n,p in old_projector.items());after=mm(ids)['logits'];assert torch.equal(before,after)

from pathlib import Path

(art/'11.7-source-raw.txt').write_bytes(section)

 import torch

 (art/('11.7-'+name+'-execution.json')).write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
